title: Atlas Finding
description: One claim, the citations it rests on, and how far those have been checked. A verdict of "verified" requires a semantic check: deterministic evidence checking can establish that a citation is sound, never that the source supports the claim.

severity_rationale.description: Why this severity. A severity without a reason reads as assessed when it is not.

evidence.description: What the finding claims about each source it cites, checked against the run's observations rather than copied from them.

source_id.description: Must name an observation from this run.

quoted.description: Must be contiguous text at the claimed line range.

verdict.description: "insufficient_evidence" is the honest default, and what BOTH an unusable citation and an intact-but-unchecked claim earn: a broken pointer says the citation is unusable, never that the claim is false. "contradicted" is reserved for a claim a semantic check has actually disproved, and "verified" is not reachable from deterministic checking at all.

reproducible_command.description: A command that re-checks the claim, or "unknown". Never blank.
